rounds.ai_message: Hi Chen, this is Daniel from the buying office. Could you give me an update on PO #2024-356? The buyer is asking about the shipping date.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈你好,我是采购办的 Daniel。订单 2024-356 进度怎么样了?客户在问船期。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认订单号,给当前生产/出货阶段的状态
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要笼统说 'It's in progress' — 要给具体阶段:in production / in QC / in packing。
rounds.tips_zh: 主动报数据(百分比、日期)比 '快了快了' 专业得多。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Daniel. Let me check — PO 2024-356. Production is about 70 percent done, and we are moving into final inspection this Friday.

rounds.ai_message: Friday? That works. What is your estimated ETD from Ningbo? The vessel they want is the MSC vessel, if possible.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 周五可以。预计什么时候从宁波开船?他们想走 MSC 的船,能配合吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给出 ETD 并确认船公司可行性
rounds.common_mistakes: ETD / ETA 容易说反:ETD=Estimated Time of Departure(离港),ETA=Estimated Time of Arrival(到港)。
rounds.tips_zh: 跟货代/船代先确认本周和下周 MSC 船期表,再给客户,不要凭印象答。
rounds.user_response_example: Sure. ETD from Ningbo is around the 18th of this month. MSC has a direct sailing to New York on the 20th. We can book your container on that one.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. What about the cut-off time? I want to make sure the cargo will be at port in time.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。截关时间是?我想确认能不能赶得上。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 给截关时间,以及工厂送货到港的安排
key_phrases: Container needs to be at yard by ...
rounds.common_mistakes: cut-off = 截关(船公司收货截止),不是装柜截止。搞混会误事。
rounds.tips_zh: 工厂装柜日、还柜到堆场日、截关日,三个时间都要心里有数。
rounds.user_response_example: The cut-off is on the 17th, by 6 PM. We will arrange stuffing at our warehouse on the 15th, and deliver the container to the yard on the 16th.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Can you send me the draft B/L once it's issued? My forwarder needs to check the consignee and notify party fields.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。提单一出来,先发我一份草稿可以吗?我货代要核对收货人和通知人。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 答应并确认信息以谁为准
key_phrases: Final B/L will follow the booking confirmation
rounds.common_mistakes: B/L 草稿确认要明确:consignee(收货人)、notify party(通知人)、shipper(发货人)三栏必查。
rounds.tips_zh: 草稿先发给货代和客户各一份,有问题改在签单前,签完就改不动了。
rounds.user_response_example: Sure. Once the booking is confirmed, I will send you the draft B/L for review. Please double-check the consignee and notify party fields.

rounds.ai_message: One more thing — do you handle the C/O? We need a Form A for the US shipment.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 还有 — 产地证你们办吗?美国这票要办普惠制 Form A。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认能办并说清楚办理方式和时间
key_phrases: Yes, we can issue the C/O
rounds.common_mistakes: C/O = Certificate of Origin(产地证);Form A 是 GSP(普惠制)产地证,用途不同别搞混。
rounds.tips_zh: 办证文件要提前准备:商业发票、装箱单、提单草本,缺一不可。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, we will issue the General C/O through the local CCPIT. Form A is also possible. The extra fee is around USD 30 per set.

rounds.ai_message: OK. What documents will the courier deliver to my office directly? My accounting team needs the invoice and packing list.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 行。哪些文件会直接快递给我办公室?财务要发票和装箱单。
rounds.common_mistakes: full set(全套)通常指:1/3 正本提单 + 商业发票 + 装箱单 + 产地证 + 保险单,别漏。
rounds.tips_zh: 正本提单要不要寄,要看客户要不要做电放(telex release)。美国客人很多走电放,省快递时间和丢件风险。
rounds.user_response_example: We will send the full set by DHL, including one original B/L, invoice, packing list, and C/O. They usually arrive within three business days after sailing.
